Environment · World

Wildfires rage across Europe, causing destruction and fatalities

Multiple wildfires are burning across Europe amidst a heatwave. In Belgium, the largest wildfire on record has consumed 3,000 hectares and is advancing towards the German border, prompting international firefighting assistance. In Greece, twin wildfires on the island of Salamina have resulted in the deaths of an elderly couple. The United Kingdom has also experienced significant fires, with "apocalyptic scenes" reported in the West Midlands, leading to thousands of emergency calls and an emergency alert sent to millions in England and Wales.
